title: New county emergency operations center
summary: As of September 17, the Maui Emergency Management Agency (MEMA) hoped its new emergency operations center would be running by October 1st, and the chair raised holding a future commission meeting there. The opening had slipped repeatedly: the move was pushed from June to July 15, then a roof leak over the computer room caused further delay.

timeline.text: MEMA staff officially moved into the new Emergency Operations Center building in Wailuku. This came after the page's latest entry of September 17.

source.quote: Maui Emergency Management Agency staff members officially moved into their new Maui Emergency Operations Center (EOC) building in Wailuku, marking a significant step in the County of Maui's work to strengthen emergency preparedness and response.
